messages:
anya: kicking off canary for thalia-30b (int4) on canary pool. quick note: evals show ~6-8% ROUGE drop vs fp16 and we saw intermittent OOMs when batch_size >= 4. rolling back if it gets worse.
kevin: paste error and config? :thinking:
anya: error snippet:
```
E 03:21:12 gpu0 memory alloc failed: out_of_memory (requested 230MB)
W 03:21:12 kv_cache: fragmented free slots = 12, largest_free=48MB
```
config used:
```
model: thalia-30b
precision: int4
batch_size: 4
max_new_tokens: 512
prefetch: enabled
kv_reserve: default
```
liam: fragmentation + int4 tends to hit allocator edges. try batch_size=2 + max_new_tokens=256 for the canary.
anya: tested batch_size=2 + max_new_tokens=256 12 OOMs stopped but quality still ~4% down on ROUGE. feels like quant error, not just mem.
kevin: did you run deterministic eval? same tokenization? maybe head-layer quant mismatch or softmax fallback.
anya: deterministic top-p=0.0, tokenization identical. seeing odd nearest-neighbor hallucinatory outputs.
liam: proposal: run two parallel experiments:
- exp-A: enable mixed_out for final layers (mixed_out=true) + batch_size=2
- exp-B: keep int4 but recompile with alternate kernel selection (prefer fp16 matmul) + max_new_tokens=256
kevin: and bump kv pruning aggressiveness: kv_prune_ms 10000 -> 5000, enable slot compaction between sessions.
anya: adding pre-load mem compact hook:
```
startup_hooks:
  - run: /usr/local/bin/gpu_mem_compact --pass 2
```
sre-bot: deploy request accepted -> canary id canary-20240306-17
anya: running exp-A and exp-B on 2 canaries each. ETA ~20m. dumping artifacts to s3 when done.
kevin: also run float32 logits on a small sample to diff top-k vs int4; that should show whether error is local to logits or sampling.
anya: will dump logits diffs for 100 eval prompts.
liam: if mixed_out fixes quality but costs more, route summarization traffic to mixed_out and keep other workloads on pure int4. smart routing rollout.
anya: interim: exp-A (mixed_out) reduces ROUGE gap to ~1.2% and no OOMs on batch_size=2. exp-B (alt kernels) ~3.8% gap but lower cost. eval artifacts: /s3/eng-ml/thalia-canary/1709876543/
kevin: good. propose product change: default max_new_tokens for thalia-30b int4 summarization route 512 -> 256 to reduce mem pressure.
liam: ops follow-ups:
- add 2 short warmup requests on instance start to avoid cold alloc spikes
- increase prefault pages for allocator on canary nodes
- schedule compaction every 6h for int4 in thalia pool
anya: creating release ticket with canary IDs, perf numbers, and evals.
product-lead: what's the cost delta for mixed_out? rough percent?
liam: estimate +8-12% token cost for mixed_out on summarization (seq-len dependent), but UX better.
product-lead: include tradeoffs in RFC. :thumbsup:
anya: will hold rollout until mixed_out passes eval parity + SLOs. posting full summary here when ready.
kevin: thanks all.
